lhv.config.title: Sublime Damage Display Config
lhv.config.player.title: Player Damage Settings
lhv.config.entity.title: Entity Damage Settings
lhv.config.env.title: Environment Damage Settings
lhv.config.global.title: Global Settings
yacl3.config.enum.RenderMode.merge.desc: §6Merge§r: All damage dealt to the same entity is summed into one number
yacl3.config.enum.RenderMode.latest.desc: §6Latest§r: Only shows the most recent damage dealt to an entity
yacl3.config.enum.RenderMode.all.desc: §6All§r: Shows every instance of damage dealt to an entity
lhv.config.damageSortMode.desc: Sorting order for overlapping damage numbers from the same source (effective when §6Display Behavior§r is set to §6All§r)
lhv.config.damageSortMode.note: To modify sorting between different entities or sources, see §6Global Settings§r
§6Latest§r: More recent damage numbers cover earlier ones
§6Oldest§r: Earlier damage numbers cover later ones
lhv.config.minVisibleRange.desc: Minimum distance for damage numbers to be visible (meters)
lhv.config.maxVisibleRange.desc: Maximum distance for damage numbers to be visible (meters)
lhv.config.trackEntity.desc: Whether damage numbers follow the entity as it moves
lhv.config.retainWhenOffScreen.desc: Whether damage numbers remain visible after the entity moves off-screen
lhv.config.displayDuration.desc: How long damage numbers persist (game ticks)
lhv.config.maxReceiveRange.desc: Maximum range for receiving damage data (meters)
lhv.config.screenOffsetRangeX.desc: Range of random horizontal offset on screen (pixels)
lhv.config.screenOffsetRangeY.desc: Range of random vertical offset on screen (pixels)
lhv.config.offsetRangeX.desc: Range of random world offset along the X axis (meters)
lhv.config.offsetRangeZ.desc: Range of random world offset along the Z axis (meters)
lhv.config.offsetRangeY.desc: Range of random world offset along the Y axis (meters)
§6Scientific§r: Always uses scientific notation for large/small numbers
yacl3.config.enum.FormatMode.unit.desc: §6Unit Suffix§r: Always uses unit suffixes (K/M/B/T) for large numbers
yacl3.config.enum.FormatMode.auto.desc: §6Auto§r: Automatically chooses the best format based on the value
yacl3.config.enum.FormatMode.raw.desc: §6Raw§r: Displays the raw value, only affected by decimal places
lhv.config.retainDecimalPlaces.desc: Number of decimal places to display
lhv.config.infinityDisplay.desc: Text to display when damage is infinite
lhv.config.nanDisplay.desc: Text to display when damage is not a number
lhv.config.unitSystem.desc: Unit system used for number formatting
yacl3.config.enum.UnitSystem.metric_pref: §6SI Metric Prefixes§r: Base-1000 units with decimal support, international standard
lhv.config.useGrouping.desc: Whether to enable digit grouping (e.g. thousand separators)
lhv.config.groupingSeparator.desc: Character used to separate digit groups
lhv.config.decimalSeparator.desc: Character used to separate integer and fractional parts
lhv.config.roundingMode.desc: Select the rounding mode for damage numbers
yacl3.config.enum.RoundingMode.up.desc: §6UP (Away from Zero)§r: Round away from zero
yacl3.config.enum.RoundingMode.half_down: §6HALF_DOWN (Half Down)§r: 0.5 rounds down, only above 0.5 rounds up
yacl3.config.enum.RoundingMode.half_even: §6HALF_EVEN (Banker's Round)§r: 0.5 rounds to the nearest even digit, reduces cumulative error
lhv.config.killDisplay.desc: Extra text shown when damage kills an entity; leave empty to disable
lhv.config.criticalColor.desc: Color for critical hit damage numbers; may be overridden by special colors (#RRGGBB)
lhv.config.criticalFormatTemplate.desc: Format string for critical damage; %s is replaced with the damage number
lhv.config.outlineEnable.desc: Whether to add an outline effect to damage numbers
lhv.config.depthToScaleRef.desc: Distance from camera at which scale is 100%. Numbers scale up when closer and down when farther (meters)
lhv.config.depthToAlphaRef.desc: Distance from camera at which opacity reaches the configured maximum. Numbers become more transparent when closer and more opaque when farther (meters)
lhv.config.punchyEffectEnable.desc: Whether to enable a more impactful punchy animation effect for damage numbers
lhv.config.entitySortMode.desc: Sorting order for overlapping damage numbers from different entities
yacl3.config.enum.EntitySortMode.nearest: §6Nearest§r: Closer to camera covers farther ones
yacl3.config.enum.EntitySortMode.farthes: §6Farthest§r: Farther from camera covers closer ones
lhv.config.sourceSortMode.desc: Sorting order for overlapping damage numbers from different sources on the same entity
§6Latest§r: More recent damage source covers earlier ones
§6Oldest§r: Earlier damage source covers later ones
lhv.config.bigNumberTestMode.desc: When enabled, damage values are displayed as larger numbers
lhv.config.infinityTestMode.desc: When enabled, all damage values will be infinite
